summary: Require distinct declared execution units and deterministic bounded-handoff chaining for credited Adaptive Execution passes, then revalidate the merged Adaptive Execution behavior under the corrected discipline.
reason: PR #5 revision 6 recorded five SEPARATED semantic stages as complete even though they were effectively evaluated within one assistant response. The existing gate/completion validator proved structural consistency of the recorded plan but could not establish that distinct semantic execution units actually occurred. This correction makes the intended execution discipline explicit and adds deterministic enforcement of unique declared execution-unit/boundary identities, ordered stage credit, hashed outbound handoffs, exact downstream consumers, next-pass consumption of the prior handoff, a closed historical exemption set, and PR-scoped durable Git chronology requiring gate-before-credit and distinct first-credit commits per pass. ISOLATED passes additionally require an isolation-boundary declaration. The repository still does not claim to prove a ChatGPT message/context boundary unless the host supplies a trustworthy boundary ID. Revision-6 same-response semantic assurance is not relied upon for this correction; the behavior is being revalidated again under revision 7 using one semantic pass per assistant message or equivalent bounded execution unit.

reasons: The final corrected scope is bounded to execution-unit separation, closed legacy exemptions, PR-scoped durable chronology, handoff chaining, isolation declarations, workflow enforcement, and assurance limits.
The material adversarial surfaces are directly represented in the final checker, workflow, mapping, reference, evaluation, and regression tests and are suitable for one bounded pass.

workload.notes: SEPARATED one-pass Adversarial review. The credited semantic pass is confined to this assistant message; no FUSED permission or subdivision is used.

capability.benchmark_evidence: Built-in separated default; not a claim of measured reviewer capability.

decision.assurance_boundary: Semantic judgment determines whether one pass is suitable and which bounded subpasses require isolation. Deterministic policy defaults to SEPARATED, converts declared isolation requirements into ISOLATED subpasses, and permits FUSED only through exact pre-existing VALIDATED capability permission. The gate and completion validator enforce the recorded plan but do not prove the semantic assessment itself was correct.

findings: No material adversarial defect remains in the corrected pass-boundary design after fixing premature review-completion targeting, closing the historical exemption set, and scoping Git chronology verification to records modified by the current PR.

The protected workflow now rejects duplicate execution-unit or boundary identities, broken or tampered handoff chains, out-of-order stage credit, missing ISOLATED context declarations, pass credit before the current gate existed durably, and multiple passes first credited in the same change-record commit.
The prior revision-6 same-response assurance is explicitly superseded for current assurance and is not relied upon by revision 7.

A repository validator still cannot independently prove a ChatGPT message/context boundary without a trustworthy host boundary identifier; this limitation is explicit and the actual one-pass-per-message discipline remains required.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 131: regression suite and pass-boundary enforcement passed; only the intentionally unresolved/stale revalidation queue remained blocking.
unresolved_conditions: The chat host does not expose a trustworthy message/context boundary identifier to the repository, so host-message separation remains an execution-discipline fact rather than independently repository-provable evidence.

supersedes_assurance.reason: The revision-6 semantic completion records overstated actual separation and are not used as evidence for revision-7 completion.
